name: RSI 14 oversold / overbought
description: MEAN REVERSION. Wilder's original rule from New Concepts in Technical Trading Systems (1978): buy when RSI(14) crosses below 30, sell when it crosses above 70. Canonical parameters, declared and not searched: 14 periods with the 30/70 thresholds is what Wilder published. BORN ON THE DAILY, on commodity futures. On M5 an RSI(14) spans a little over an hour and reaches its extremes several times a day, so the rule fires far more often against far smaller moves. Exits on ATR: the reversion target is one unit of current volatility, the stop two.
